title: Debt and credit
learning_outcomes: Explain interest in the context of debt and credit.
Compare and distinguish fees and repayment in the context of debt and credit.
Apply borrowing trade-offs in the context of debt and credit.
Evaluate and justify decisions about hardship options in the context of debt and credit.

lessons.title: Interest
lessons.outcome: Explain interest in the context of debt and credit.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving interest; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to debt comparison spreadsheet.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain interest from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of interest; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Fees and repayment
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish fees and repayment in the context of debt and credit.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving fees and repayment; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to debt comparison spreadsheet.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain fees and repayment from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of fees and repayment; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Borrowing trade-offs
lessons.outcome: Apply borrowing trade-offs in the context of debt and credit.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving borrowing trade-offs; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to debt comparison spreadsheet.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain borrowing trade-offs from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of borrowing trade-offs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Hardship options
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about hardship options in the context of debt and credit.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving hardship options; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to debt comparison spreadsheet.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain hardship options from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of hardship options; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of interest; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of fees and repayment; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of borrowing trade-offs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of hardship options; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
